picks.detail: WeAreBrain’s Truck Tyre Assist case describes supplier notifications, acceptance handling and status updates in an ERP workflow. In a trial, ask two suppliers to respond to one case. Check that a dispatcher can see who accepted it and what happens to the second response.

AY Automate’s published compliance project describes replacing manual checks in a festival staffing workflow. Bring synthetic records with a mismatch, a missing field and an expiring document. Look for a clear review queue and ask who is allowed to override a result.

The ZF case documents Capgemini’s work on a global automation service. For a buyer with several candidate workflows, the first deliverable could be a prioritized backlog. Ask each process owner to identify the exception that consumes the most time, then check whether the proposed pilot includes it.

methodology: The first group focuses on workflow delivery. The list also includes larger practices for buyers who need systems integration or a multi-team rollout. Display order carries no quality score.
questions: Bring five anonymized examples, including a duplicate and an incomplete request.
Ask to see the audit trail for one completed run and one failed run.
Before handover, have your operator replay a failed job and confirm that it creates only one downstream record.
pricing: Compare the setup fee, support retainer and per-run costs at your normal and peak volumes. Ask whether connector changes and failed-job investigation are included.

firms.name: AY Automate
firms.note: Builds AI automations and publishes delivery case studies. Ask who owns each integration after handover.

firms.name: WeAreBrain
firms.note: Offers workflow automation and integration. Bring a process that crosses two systems and ask how failed writes are reconciled.

firms.name: Goodspeed
firms.note: Describes n8n workflows and AI agents for operations teams. Ask for an example of a workflow your own team could maintain.

firms.name: LowCode Agency
firms.note: Publishes a guide to AI agents that run business processes. Ask for a walkthrough of the approval and exception paths.

firms.name: Capgemini
firms.note: Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. Ask how the team handles process exceptions.

firms.name: IBM Consulting
firms.note: Offers artificial intelligence consulting. Ask for a design showing how existing applications and data will connect.

firms.name: Slalom
firms.note: Describes AI consulting for enterprise teams. Ask who will build alongside your engineers and support the first release.

firms.name: Deloitte
firms.note: Groups engineering, AI and data delivery in one practice. Ask how platform work and application delivery would be costed separately.

firms.name: Accenture
firms.note: Publishes an AI services offering under the Texas DIR contract. Check the scope and purchasing terms applicable to your organization.

firms.name: BCG
firms.note: Combines strategy and applied AI. Ask which operating decisions the first engagement would change.
